0022600097.text: The Wizards host the Raptors in their second game of the 2026-27 season, with Washington sitting 1-0 at home and 2nd in the Southeast, 5th in the East, while Toronto is also 1-0, 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost the season series 1-2, including a 134-125 loss to the Raptors in Washington on February 28, 2026.
